title: The Ant and the Elephant play hide and seek (चींटी और हाथी की छुपन-छुपाई)

topics.title: Reading piece: a riddle about an ant and an elephant playing hide and seek
topics.why_no_lab: It is a short read-only riddle with one fixed answer; the child should think and discuss it, so a screen lab would give the answer away.

topics.title: Talk: who is bigger, and who can hide better?
topics.why_no_lab: Pure conversation about size; the picture and a chat with a teacher teach it best.
